title: The Game Awards 2026 will stream on Disney+ 🏆
subject: gameawards
description:
What do you want to see revealed on December 10? 👇

The Game Awards 2026 will stream live on Disney+ for the first time on Thursday, December 10 at 7:30 p.m. ET from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Disney says the show will feature some of its most anticipated games.

Sources: ABC7 Los Angeles (Nov 12, 2026), Gaming Trend (Nov 12, 2026), GoSuGamers, GameSpot

scenes.text: The Game Awards now has a Disney+ deal.
For the first time, the show streams live on Disney+, on Thursday, December 10, at 7:30 p.m. Eastern.
scenes.search: streaming app on tv screen living room

scenes.text: Geoff Keighley is producing again, live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.
Disney says the night will feature some of its most anticipated titles in gaming.
It didn't name a single one. Fans are already guessing Star Wars Jedi 3.
Nominees and fan voting will be posted later on the official Game Awards site.
